_doc: Optional stair finishes (src/stair_finishes.py). timber_flights get a wood tread on an adhesive bed per step (the concrete core is lowered by the build-up); metal_railings colours every stair balustrade and interior void guard except excluded_railings; handrails use the treads colour. Delete this file to build bare concrete stairs.

props.Product: Oak block tread 37 mm on 3 mm adhesive
Precast concrete flight with timber treads
